text: 10月制造业大型企业PMI为50.2%，比上月下降0.4个百分点，仍位于扩张区间；中型企业和小型企业PMI分别为48.4%和47.5%，比上月下降1.3个和1.4个百分点，景气水平均有回落。
text_en: In October, the PMI for large manufacturing enterprises was 50.2%, down 0.4 percentage points from the previous month but still in expansion territory; the PMIs for medium and small enterprises were 48.4% and 47.5%, respectively, down 1.3 and 1.4 percentage points from the previous month, with business conditions deteriorating in both.
